requiredClaims.meaning: The handoff records peer-A connecting to the SmartConnect listener at TCP 52492.
The handoff records VaultPlugin initiating a connection to peer-B TCP 8009 and outbound Internet connections on TCP 5228.
The handoff records loopback communication distinct from local-peer and Internet interactions.
Neither peer-A nor peer-B has an established physical device identity.
